faqs.question: What food are accepted?
patterns: What type of food does FoodReach accept?
faqs.answer: FoodReach accepts suitable surplus food such as cooked meals, fresh fruits and vegetables, bakery items, packaged food, and groceries. All donated food must be fresh, safe, and suitable for consumption.

faqs.question: Can I donate cooked food?
patterns: can we give warm cooked food?
can I donate warm cooked food?
faqs.answer: Yes! Cooked food can be donated provided it is fresh, safely prepared, stored in clean sealed containers, and donated within 4 to 6 hours of preparation.

faqs.question: Can I donate vegetables?
faqs.answer: Yes! Fresh, unspotted raw vegetables and farm produce are accepted for donation.

faqs.question: Can I donate fruits?
faqs.answer: Yes! Fresh, wholesome fruits can be donated through FoodReach.

faqs.question: Can I donate expired food?
faqs.answer: No. Expired, spoiled, or unsafe food is strictly prohibited from donation to ensure food safety and community health.

faqs.question: How do I donate food?
patterns: How to create a food donation?
what is the process for food donation?
faqs.answer: To donate food, open the 'Create Donation' screen from your Donor Dashboard, enter the food details (type, quantity, shelf life, and pickup address), and tap 'List Food Donation'.

faqs.question: How do NGOs work?
patterns: What do NGOs do on FoodReach?
How does an NGO claim food?
faqs.answer: NGOs on FoodReach browse nearby surplus food listings on their dashboard map, claim available donations, and coordinate pickup to distribute food to community shelters and people in need.

faqs.question: How can an NGO register?
patterns: How to register as an NGO?
How do I sign up my organization?
faqs.answer: NGOs can register by tapping 'Create Account' on the Sign Up screen, selecting the 'NGO' role, submitting organization details, serving capacity, and marking their location on the map.

faqs.question: How can an NGO register?
patterns: How to register as an NGO?
How do I sign up my organization?
faqs.answer: NGOs can register by tapping 'Create Account' on the Sign Up screen, selecting the 'NGO' role, submitting organization details, serving capacity, and marking their location on the map.

faqs.question: How can I become a volunteer?
patterns: How can I become a volunteer?
How to register as a volunteer?
faqs.answer: You can become a volunteer by registering with the 'Volunteer' role on FoodReach. Volunteers accept pickup assignments, collect food from donors, verify pickup codes, and deliver meals to assigned NGO shelters.

faqs.question: What are the food safety guidelines?
patterns: What are the food safety guidelines?
faqs.answer: Food safety is maintained through mandatory Freshness Scoring, clean container packaging, temperature control, and fast 6-digit pickup verification. Food showing signs of spoilage is strictly rejected.

faqs.question: How do I use the FoodReach app?
patterns: How do I use the FoodReach app?
What features are available in the app?
faqs.answer: FoodReach connects Donors, NGOs, and Volunteers. You can list food, track live GPS deliveries, verify pickups with 6-digit codes, view impact stats, and receive role-based notifications.

faqs.question: How do I log in?
patterns: How to sign in to my account?
faqs.answer: To log in, tap 'Sign In' on the welcome screen, enter your registered email address and password, and tap Login to access your personalized dashboard.

faqs.question: How do I sign up?
faqs.answer: To create an account, tap 'Create Account' on the Sign In screen, select your role (Donor, NGO, or Volunteer), fill in your details and address, and submit the form.

faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
patterns: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Click 'Forgot Password?' on the Login screen, enter your registered email address, and follow the instructions or enter the reset code sent to your email.

faqs.question: How do I track my donation?
patterns: How do I track my donation?
What happens after my donation is accepted?
what happens once my donation is claimed?
what happens after my donation is claimed?
faqs.answer: After an NGO claims your donation, the status updates to 'Accepted'. You can track progress on the 'Track Donation' screen as a volunteer is assigned, picks up the food ('Picked Up'), and completes delivery ('Completed').

faqs.question: How does the pickup process work?
patterns: How does the pickup process work?
faqs.answer: Once a donation is claimed, a nearby volunteer is assigned. The volunteer travels to the donor address, verifies the mandatory 6-digit pickup code with the donor, picks up the food, and delivers it to the NGO.

faqs.question: How do notifications work?
patterns: Where do I find my notifications?
faqs.answer: Tap the bell icon in the top header to open your Notification Center. You will receive real-time updates when your donation is claimed, a volunteer is assigned, or a pickup is verified.

faqs.question: How do I update my profile?
patterns: How do I update my profile?
How to edit my profile details?
How to change my address or phone number?
how do I edit contact details?
faqs.answer: Open the Profile screen from the top navigation bar or menu, edit your name, contact number, or address, and tap 'Save Profile'.

faqs.question: How do I change my password?
patterns: How do I change my password?
faqs.answer: Go to your Profile screen, scroll to the Account Security section, tap 'Change Password', enter your current password and new password, and save changes.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: You can contact FoodReach support by emailing support@foodreach.org or calling our helpline at +91 98765 43210. Our team is available 24/7.

faqs.answer: Hello! Welcome to FoodReach Assistant. How can I help you with food donations, NGOs, volunteers, food safety, or tracking today?

faqs.question: Thank you
faqs.answer: You are very welcome! Thank you for being a part of the FoodReach food rescue community.

faqs.question: Goodbye
faqs.answer: Goodbye! Have a wonderful day, and thank you for making an impact with FoodReach.
